title: Zig: Strings
description: Work with strings in Zig using string literals and arrays.

steps.title: String Declaration
steps.description: Declare `const greeting: []const u8 = "Hello"` and `const name: []const u8 = "Zig"`. Concatenate them using `std.mem.concat` or print them separately. Print the length of the combined string.
hints: Strings in Zig are `[]const u8` (slices of bytes).
